'''Solay rocket ships''' were rocket-propelled [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in use on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Solay]]. The craft were one-person ships with space for only one [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. At least one ship was present at the [[Solay Spaceport]] when the ex-[[King/Legends|King]] [[Blackart]] attempted to escape the world. Blackart commandeered one of the ships and was in the process of escaping Solay when he was cut off by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Skywalker used a [[wing pack]] in conjunction with a [[jump platform]] to attack the ship with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The Jedi cut the top off of the craft, causing it to crash-land near the spaceport.
